review_candidates.description: Fundado em 1997 e guiado pelos pilares de excelência e inovação, o Grupo Elettromec é a maior House of Brands de eletrodomésticos de luxo no Brasil, com marcas próprias e distribuição exclusiva de grifes internacionais em um portfólio que atende diferentes perfis dentro do alto padrão. Elettromec é referência no segmento de luxo, com soluções completas para cozinhas e áreas gourmet. Invita atua no segmento premium, oferecendo funcionalidade e qualidade com design contemporâneo. A Fulgor Milano combina a herança artesanal italiana com tecnologias inovadoras para fornecer eletrodomésticos capazes de transmitir toda a essência de la dolce vita. Já a norte-americana Viking oferece performance profissional para a cozinha residencial por meio de soluções completas que elevam qualquer preparo. Estamos presentes nas mais conceituadas boutiques de eletrodomésticos por todo país, além de contar com 14 lojas próprias nas cidades de Campinas (SP), Piracicaba (SP), Barueri (SP), Santo André (SP), Rio de Janeiro (RJ), Curitiba (PR), Balneário Camboriú (SC), Porto Alegre (RS), Recife (PE), Salvador (BA), Fortaleza (CE), Campo Grande (MS), Goiânia (GO) e São Paulo (SP). Nesta posição, você terá atuação próxima às áreas de negócio, conectando processos, tecnologia e desenvolvimento , identificando oportunidades de melhoria e transformando necessidades do negócio em soluções no ERP e nos sistemas integrados. A posição combina atuação funcional e técnica , envolvendo sustentação do Protheus, desenvolvimento em ADVPL/TL++ , SQL, integrações, APIs, WMS/TMS, dispositivos utilizados na operação logística e projetos de evolução do ambiente. Requisitos e qualificações Experiência profissional com TOTVS Protheus; Experiência com processos de Materiais, Estoque, Logística e/ou Qualidade; Experiência com os módulos SIGAFAT, SIGAEST, SIGAACD e SIGAOMS; Conhecimento de WMS e TMS e suas integrações com o ERP; Conhecimentos em ADVPL/TL++, Framework Protheus, SQL e banco de dados; Conhecimento em ZPL / ZPL II (Zebra Programming Language); Experiência com APIs e integrações entre sistemas; Capacidade de atuar tanto na análise funcional quanto no desenvolvimento técnico das soluções. Conhecimentos desejáveis: Conhecimento dos módulos SIGAQIE (Inspeção de Entradas) e SIGAQNC (Controle de Não Conformidades); Experiência com coletores de dados e impressoras térmicas em ambientes logísticos; Experiência com GMUD, documentação, treinamentos e implantação de sistemas; Experiência em projetos de integração entre Protheus e sistemas de WMS, TMS ou outros sistemas corporativos. review_candidates.description: Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined. (NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year —if you're a better fit for another role, we'll route your application accordingly and if we're not quite ready for you, we'll reach back out later.) At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That's why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers , don't just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don't just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers. As an Administrative Operations Specialist , you will be an essential partner to an Oceans client, managing their professional life and helping them stay organized, on track, and focused on high-priority goals. You'll handle their work-related calendars, correspondence, and administrative tasks, all while ensuring seamless communication across various internal and external teams. This role requires exceptional organization, the ability to anticipate needs, and the ability to communicate effectively. You'll play an important role in streamlining operations and helping your client achieve success without taking on management responsibilities or representing them in meetings. Accountability Your success as an Administrative Operations Specialist will be measured by your ability to keep your client's professional life running smoothly, allowing them to focus on their highest-value tasks . Here's how you'll make an impact: Work Calendar & Scheduling Management Manage and optimize your client's work calendar, scheduling meetings, appointments, and events based on business priorities Coordinate meetings with internal teams, clients, and other stakeholders, ensuring efficient use of their time Organize and prioritize daily tasks, meetings, and follow-ups to ensure deadlines are met Handle business travel arrangements based on the client's work schedule and specific needs Correspondence & Communication Serve as the point of contact for your client's emails, phone calls, and other professional communication, ensuring responses are timely and professional Manage and streamline the flow of information to ensure your client receives all the relevant updates and data they need Prepare and organize materials for meetings, including agendas, presentations, and reports Employee & Client Relations Act as a liaison between your client and their internal teams, ensuring smooth communication and follow-through on tasks and initiatives Help manage positive and productive relationships with key stakeholders Provide logistical support for client-facing meetings, including coordination of schedules, follow-ups, and additional requirements Task & Project Coordination Coordinate small-scale projects and tasks that align with your client's strategic goals, tracking progress and ensuring all milestones are achieved Research and compile information as needed for ongoing tasks or initiatives Assist with ensuring deadlines are met, proactively following up on open tasks Colleagues Your primary stakeholder will be the Executive you support, working alongside their internal teams and external stakeholders. You'll help manage the flow of information and keep the work environment organized, enabling your client to focus on the strategic aspects of their role. At Oceans, you'll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you're continuously growing and developing in your career. Skills And Qualifications At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As an Administrative Operations Specialist, your vertical focus will be on professional administration, ensuring smooth operations through efficient scheduling, communication, and task management. Your horizontal focus will span organizational efficiency, stakeholder management, and proactive problem-solving, enabling you to adapt to different demands and support your client effectively. To excel in this role, you should have: Language Skills: Professional fluency in English, with excellent reading, writing, and speaking abilities Experience: At least 5 years in a communication-heavy role at a reputable firm, demonstrating strong interpersonal and organizational skills Education: An undergraduate degree is preferred, though relevant work experience is also valued. Certifications such as an MBA, CFA, CIM, CIPM, or CIMA will be considered as an added advantage Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported. During the interview process, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas: Empathy: How comfortable are you with putting yourself in the shoes of the other person and anticipating needs? Time Management & Adaptability: How do you handle multiple tasks and shifting deadlines while staying organized? Communication: Can you manage professional communication and correspondence while maintaining professionalism and clarity? Stakeholder Coordination: How do you effectively work with teams and external parties to ensure everything runs smoothly while balancing multiple priorities? Attention to Detail: How do you ensure accuracy in meeting preparation and follow-ups? Taking Initiative and Ownership: How do you go above and beyond your given tasks to add value and drive efficiency? Problem-Solving: How do you handle scheduling conflicts and other administrative challenges? Tech Proficiency: What digital tools or software have you used to streamline tasks and improve workflows? Role Specifications This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client's time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we'll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors. About Oceans At Oceans Talent, we connect the world's top talent with visionary companies building what's next. Here, you're not just stepping into another role — you're joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you. We're always excited to share more about our journey, where we're headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process. Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].
